abstract: Choriocarcinoma most commonly follows a molar pregnancy, but it may develop after any gestational event. If choriocarcinoma follows a term pregnancy, it is associated with an unfavorable outcome and a 60% survival rate. A 33 year female who had delivered a normal girl 4 months before, presented with a nodule on the scalp behind the right ear. The pathologic diagnosis was compatible with metastatic choriocarcinoma. This tumor did not respond to chemotherapy, and she died a year later of multiple liver and pulmonary metastases. The development of a choriocarcinoma following a full term pregnancy is associated with a poor prognosis. We suggest that patients who do not achieve a clinical or serological remission after EMA-CO treatment be considered for high dose chemotherapy such as transplant.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌は通常、胞状奇胎妊娠に続いて発生するが、あらゆる妊娠イベント後に発生しうる。絨毛癌が正期産後に発生した場合、予後は不良で、生存率は60%とされる。33歳女性は4か月前に正常な女児を出産しており、右耳後部の頭皮に結節が出現した。病理診断は転移性絨毛癌に一致した。この腫瘍は化学療法に反応せず、1年後に肝および肺の多発転移により死亡した。正期産後の絨毛癌の発生は予後不良と関連する。EMA-CO療法後に臨床的または血清学的寛解が得られない患者には、移植を伴う大量化学療法の適応を検討すべきと考える。
